posts.title: Truth, bullshit and reputation
posts.description: Bullshit: a prose-like substance which, on the first sight, looks like it has substance - but it's lacking it. Characterised by being order-of-magnitude harder to dismiss than to produce. It abuses norms of good-faith intellectual engagement. Truth: what actually is, not what someone believes or wishes to be. At odds with motivated reasoning. Reputation: a tool for saving effort on verifying claim

posts.title: Cost of time
posts.description: Spending 15 minutes on a call with insurance annoys me much more than it "should" but I think my feelings are correct here. I can only call the insurance company Monday to Friday, 7am to 7pm. Mornings are for getting my son ready, commute is too loud for a call, work break is for resting, evenings are for dinner and family time. I have maybe like an hour a day when I could make the call.
